note: Supports-on before/after for the four cells the exact-Z body rejection dropped support on, the four supports-off identity checks, the recovered-layer census on the t147 metric, the immediate-candidate coverage reading, and the matched-pair wall medians for the four supports-on cells.

metric.support_path: t147 parser: extruding G1/G0 distance under a Support* feature, Support + Support interface
metric.coverage: fraction of the candidate overhang polygon covered by support paths buffered by 0.2 mm (t147's metric)
metric.wall: median of 3 measured uninstrumented runs, 1 warmup, RAYON_NUM_THREADS=12

disclosures: The four supports-off cells are byte-identical to the t144 active set and were not re-recorded; only the four supports-on cells moved.
No accelerated timing arm: the accelerated host remains unbuildable in libmimalloc-sys (t142/t145 disclosure).
The wall window is a different window from t145; Orca's own medians moved between the two batches, so no causal wall cost is claimed from the cross-take deltas.
Candidate coverage is reported, not used as a pass gate: PnP tree interfaces do not cover whole overhang polygons even on layers the gate never dropped (see retained_layer_control).
